scope: All 128 entries and cross-entry comparisons reviewed; no board access, model run or rankings.
checks_passed: 128 unique atoms and no skill steps

near_neighbor_decisions.reason: OK为圆环且其余三指伸开；指心为拇食交叉且三指收拢；空捏为指腹相对且三指收拢。
机械头与屏幕瞳孔不同通道，左右方向明确。
作用眼、事件/持续状态及上下眼睑轮廓不同。
单侧、同步双臂侧展、上举V不同终态；不是数值角度档位。
单手指心、双手心形、屏幕爱心输出不同，不静默互换。

findings.resolution: 固定掌板或已张开手为持续前置；握拳拒绝，不插张手动作。
控制通道与潜在受影响部位分列；肩/腰联动不隐瞒。
机械wrist通道保守包含同侧arm影响。

limitations: This is a design specification, not 128 physically implemented or verified actions.
All hardware inventories and preset mappings remain unknown; real runtime must exclude unmapped candidates.
Textual uniqueness is not physical uniqueness: deduplicate actual assets/trajectories after implementation.
Cancellation, mechanical noise, reachability, limits, collision safety, real kinesthetic coupling and execution sequence remain untested.
Top3/Top5 quality requires new frozen queries and compatibility review; previous 35+20 results do not apply.
